newsitem.title: CHINA: First Shanghai lifts stake in Goodbaby.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai lifts stake in Goodbaby.

text.p: First Shanghai Investments Ltd said on Wednesday that China Assets (Holdings) Ltd had agreed to sell its entire 33 percent interest in Goodbaby Child Products Co Ltd for US$10 million.
The company said the deal would lift its stake in the children's products maker and seller to 66.01 percent from 33.01 percent, and would be funded by internal financial resources.
China Assets, which is 20-percent owned by First Shanghai, said in a separate statement that the disposal would enable the company to realise a profit of about US$5.50 million.

Goodbaby, a Sino-foreign joint venture in China, posed net profit of 22.46 million yuan for the year ended December 31, 1996, against 20.35 million yuan the previous year. Its audited net asset value on June 30, 1997, was 156.44 million yuan.
First Shanghai said Goodbaby is a market leader in China and it believed the acquisition provided an excellent opportunity to increase its exposure to the market of children's products.

Earlier this month First Shanghai said it was in talks with Yaohan International Holdings Ltd to buy Yaohan's entire 35.23 percent stake in amusement centre operator Whimsy Entertainment Co Ltd, but noted negotiations were at a preliminary stage and the acquistion might or might not proceed.
